purpose: Editorial illustrations for the approved secondary-page readability revision; not client evidence.

images.name: working-together
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one polished landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for ExFu, a human-focused AI consultancy website. Scene: a close, gently elevated view of a shared wooden working table, two colleagues seen only as cropped shoulders and natural hands, calmly working through a practical decision together. One hand points with a rust-red pencil to a simple paper prototype, another holds a small cream note. A few organised pages, a modest open laptop with abstract blank interface shapes, one cup. Focus on the tangible work and collaboration, not faces. Composition has breathing room, few objects, strong clear silhouette, large areas of warm off-white paper. Style: sensitive hand-drawn graphite and charcoal crosshatching with subtle warm watercolour washes, matching thoughtful pencil portrait illustrations. Cream, muted putty, mushroom and charcoal palette with very restrained brick-red accents. Quiet, confident, human and contemporary; beautiful editorial drawing, not corporate stock art. No words, letters, labels, logos, watermark, charts with invented metrics, robots, glowing brains or futuristic effects. Opaque warm ivory background. This depicts an illustrative working scene, not a real client or testimonial.

images.name: a-place-to-return
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for ExFu personal AI support. A calm close elevated view of a personal desk, a person's single natural hand placing one small loose cream note into an open paper notebook with three simple ordered sections. Several loose notes remain to the left, a plain folder and a laptop with a few abstract blank interface shapes to the right. Narrative: giving scattered work a place to return to. One rust-red pencil, no excess props. A warm human working scene with enough negative space to feel manageable, no dramatic before/after or guaranteed transformation. Style: exquisitely hand-drawn graphite and charcoal crosshatching, delicate warm watercolour washes, textured ivory paper ground, matching thoughtful pencil portrait illustrations. Colours limited to warm cream, pale putty, mushroom grey and graphite, very small brick red accents. Quiet, inviting, tactile and contemporary. Only one hand. No legible text, no letters, labels, logos, watermark, faces, robots, sparkles, futuristic imagery or glowing AI brains. Opaque ivory background. This is an illustrative narrative image for a consultancy, not a real client account.

images.name: workbench-panorama
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ULTRA-WIDE PANORAMIC editorial illustration, 3:1 landscape ratio, designed for an even shallower full-width website strip. Entire narrative and important objects must fit inside the central horizontal third of the image height, with generous quiet ivory space above and below so it crops elegantly to 5:1 on desktop and 3:1 on mobile. A long shared workbench viewed from a low elevated angle stretches horizontally across the image: a few loosely arranged blank cream notes at left, a simple paper prototype and rust-red pencil near centre, a neatly closed notebook and a modest open laptop at right. Tactile stages of thoughtful practical work. No people or hands. No clutter, no plant decorations, no floating elements. Render as sophisticated graphite and charcoal line drawing with delicate crosshatching and restrained warm watercolour washes, warm ivory paper ground, pale putty and mushroom greys, small brick-red accents. Quiet breathing space. Match literary pencil portrait illustration rather than flat vector corporate art. No readable text, numbers, logos, watermark, arrows, robots, glowing networks or fake graphs. Objects should be fully framed with substantial horizontal space separating them and should not fill the canvas height. This is an atmospheric editorial illustration, not a literal process diagram.
